pages.title: Spirit Pulse
pages.text: Pulse comes from rhythm, landscape and harmony. Keep a generator within 8 blocks of your workshop. Machines draw from generators first, then totem buffers.

pages.title: Drumheart
pages.text: Strike empty-handed. Beats about one second apart yield 24 Pulse; offbeat hits yield 10. Redstone rising edges give 5, with an 8-tick cooldown. Build a clock to automate rhythm.

pages.title: Ley Collector
pages.text: Open sky, night, rain, nearby water and living greenery strengthen collection. Place it thoughtfully. A redstone signal pauses generation.

pages.title: Pulse Resonator
pages.text: This is not a furnace. Coal and wood do nothing.$(br)$(br)1. Place the Resonator.$(br)2. Right-click it with an Echo catalyst (start with an Echo Shard).$(br)3. Place two different Resonance Totems within 8 blocks.$(br)4. It lights and makes Pulse. The crystal stays seated.$(br)5. Sneak empty-handed to lift the catalyst.

pages.name: First Resonator
pages.text: Click Visualize, then seat an Echo Shard. Two different voices within 8 is the whole of it.

pages.title: What is a catalyst?
pages.text: A reusable crystal you seat in the Resonator. None of them burn.$(br)$(br)Rank 1 Echo Shard — shatter stone in Echo Shatter.$(br)Rank 2 Attuned Echo — Echo Attune + Fire.$(br)Rank 3 Bound Echo — Echo Bind + Water.$(br)Rank 4 Resonant Core — Echo Manifest + Spirit.$(br)$(br)Gain each second is (2 × voices) + (2 × rank). Two voices and a shard is 6 Pulse/s.

pages.title: Echo Shard
pages.text: The first catalyst. Shatter stone, deepslate or March stone — cobble is the hammer chain, not shards. Right-click the Resonator with one shard to seat it.

pages.name: Voice Ring
pages.text: Totems at radius 3, same floor. A heap nearby only counts five voices; six needs this ring. Mix the six voices among the eight slots.

pages.title: Carry the beat
pages.text: Use a Pulse Cell on a Drumheart or Resonator to charge it. Ordinary cells hold 200 Pulse; Greater Cells hold 1,200. Carry charged cells for spells, tools and travel. A lever on the Resonator pauses it.
